post.description: Map a call object to a CRM object using the provided engagement ID and external call ID. This endpoint is useful for integrating third-party calling systems with HubSpot, allowing calls to be associated with CRM records.

get.description: Retrieve the connection statuses for calling extensions associated with specified user IDs. This endpoint provides information about whether users are connected to the calling service, which can be useful for monitoring and managing user connectivity.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: An array of user IDs for which to retrieve connection statuses. Each ID should be an integer.

post.description: Retrieve the connection statuses for a batch of users in a single request. This endpoint is useful for efficiently checking the calling connection status of multiple users without making individual requests for each user.

get.description: Retrieve the calling connection status for the current user. This endpoint provides information on whether the user is connected to a calling provider, which can be useful for verifying connectivity before initiating calls.

post.description: Create an inbound call record in HubSpot using third-party call data. This endpoint allows you to log details of completed calls, including caller and recipient information, call status, and engagement properties. It is useful for integrating third-party calling systems with HubSpot to maintain a comprehensive call log.

Record details of an inbound call using the HubSpot API. This endpoint allows you to submit information about a completed third-party call, including engagement properties and call status. It's useful for logging call interactions and maintaining accurate records within your CRM.

Mark a call recording as ready by providing the engagement ID. This endpoint is useful for signaling that a recording is available for further processing or retrieval. It requires a valid engagement ID to be included in the request body.

get.description: Retrieve the channel connection settings for a specific portal in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides details about the connected channels, including their status and configuration. It is useful for managing and verifying the integration settings of calling channels associated with your portal.

parameters.name: portalId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the portal for which to retrieve channel connection settings.

post.description: Create a new transcript for a call or meeting event in your HubSpot account. This endpoint requires a JSON request body with the objectId, objectType, and transcriptUtterances. The operation is successful if it returns a 201 status code along with the location URL of the newly created transcript resource.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve the transcript associated with a specific CRM object in the HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for accessing the transcript data of calls or meetings linked to CRM objects, identified by their type and ID.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the CRM object for which the transcript is being retrieved.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of the CRM object for which the transcript is being retrieved, such as 'CALL' or 'MEETING_EVENT'.

get.description: Retrieve a specific transcript by its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access the details of a transcript, which may include information such as the transcript's creation date, associated object type, and the utterances within the transcript. This can be useful for reviewing call or meeting transcripts stored in your HubSpot account.

parameters.name: transcriptId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to retrieve.

delete.description: Delete a specific transcript in your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation will remove the transcript permanently, and it cannot be recovered once deleted.

parameters.name: transcriptId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to delete.

get.description: Retrieve the settings for a specific calling app in HubSpot. This endpoint is useful for developers who need to access the configuration details of their calling app, such as its URL, dimensions, and feature support. The response includes information about the app's readiness and capabilities.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose settings are to be retrieved. It is an integer.

post.description: Create or update the settings for a specific calling app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure various settings such as the app's name, URL, dimensions, and capabilities like inbound calling support. It requires the app ID to identify the specific app whose settings are being managed.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose settings are being configured. It is an integer.

delete.description: Delete the settings for a specific calling extension application in your HubSpot account. This operation will remove the configuration associated with the specified appId, effectively disabling any custom settings that were previously applied.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling extension application whose settings are to be deleted. It is an integer value.

patch.description: Update the settings for a specific calling app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify various settings such as the app's name, URL, dimensions, and capabilities like inbound calling support. It is useful for developers who need to adjust the configuration of their calling integrations.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose settings are to be updated.

get.description: Retrieve the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides details about the connection status and configuration for the specified app, allowing developers to verify and manage integration settings.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve channel connection settings. This should be an integer.

post.description: Create or update the channel connection settings for a specific app in HubSpot. This endpoint allows developers to configure the readiness and URL of the channel connection, which is essential for integrating third-party calling services with HubSpot. It is useful for managing and customizing the calling experience within the HubSpot platform.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the channel connection settings are being configured. It is an integer value.

delete.description: Remove the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This operation will delete the configuration associated with the app's channel connection, effectively disconnecting it.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the channel connection settings are to be deleted.

patch.description: Update the channel connection settings for a specific app in HubSpot. This endpoint allows developers to modify the settings related to the channel connection of their app, ensuring it is ready and properly configured. The request must include the necessary settings details in the request body.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the channel connection settings are being updated.

get.description: Retrieve the event webhook settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to view the current webhook target URL and other related settings for the specified app ID.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve webhook settings. It must be an integer.

put.description: Update the event webhook settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure the target URL for receiving event notifications related to calling extensions. It is useful for integrating external systems with HubSpot's calling features by setting up webhooks to listen for specific events.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the webhook settings are being updated.

post.description: Create a new event webhook for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to set up a webhook URL to receive event notifications related to calling activities. It is essential for integrating external systems with HubSpot's calling features.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the webhook is being created. It must be an integer.

delete.description: Delete the event webhooks settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This operation will remove the webhook configuration associated with the given appId, effectively stopping any event notifications from being sent to the previously configured webhook URL.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event webhooks settings are to be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve the current event webhook subscriptions for a specific app in the HubSpot account. This endpoint allows developers to view all the event types that the app is subscribed to, which can include events such as ticket creation, call creation, and call updates.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve event webhook subscriptions.

post.description: Subscribe to specific event types for a given app in HubSpot's calling extension. This endpoint allows developers to set up webhook subscriptions for events such as ticket creation, call creation, and call updates. This is useful for integrating with external systems that need to react to these events in real-time.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event subscription is being created.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: The type of event to subscribe to. Valid values are 'TICKET_CREATED', 'CALL_CREATED', and 'CALL_UPDATED'.

delete.description: Delete a specific event webhook subscription for a given app in the HubSpot CRM calling extension. This operation is useful for managing and cleaning up webhook subscriptions that are no longer needed or relevant.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the webhook subscription is being deleted.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: The type of event for which the webhook subscription is created. Valid values are 'TICKET_CREATED', 'CALL_CREATED', and 'CALL_UPDATED'.

get.description: Retrieve the recording settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access the URL used to retrieve authenticated recordings for the specified app. It is useful for developers who need to manage or audit call recordings associated with their applications.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve recording settings. It must be an integer.

post.description: Update the recording settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure the URL used to retrieve authenticated recordings. It is essential for managing how recording data is accessed and utilized within your application.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the recording settings are being updated.

patch.description: Update the recording settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the URL used to retrieve authenticated recordings. It is useful for maintaining up-to-date recording configurations for your app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the recording settings are being updated.
